description: Use when someone asks what size dining table fits a room, how many people a table seats, or how big a room must be for a table for a number of people. Uses UK stock table sizes and the space a chair needs behind it.

clearance.description: The gap behind the chairs: tight, no_traffic (to a wall), edge_past or walk_past (someone passes).

mode.description: room (start from the room’s size) or people (start from how many people).

people.description: In people mode: the number of people.

room_length_cm.description: In room mode: the room’s length (cm).

room_width_cm.description: In room mode: the room’s width (cm).
